items.review_rationale: Read monoid as set with internal associative binary operation and two-sided identity, without inverse axioms; distinct from group.

references.context: For all a,b,c∈M, (a star b) star c equals a star (b star c).
There exists e such that e star a=a=a star e for all a∈M.

references.disposition: A monoid need not be a group; all group elements have inverses, monoid elements may not.

items.review_rationale: Read nonnegative extended-valued measure on sigma-algebra with empty-set zero and countable additivity over disjoint measurable sequences.

references.context: Allowed measure values are finite nonnegative real numbers or +∞.
Empty measurable set assigned zero mass.
For any pairwise disjoint E_n in Sigma, μ(union E_n)=sum μ(E_n).

references.disposition: Countable disjoint unions are required; total mass μ(X) need not be one.

items.review_rationale: Read finite degree of nonzero univariate polynomial over commutative unital ring as largest index with nonzero coefficient, excluding zero polynomial finite degree.

references.context: Finite formal sum of monomial coefficients a_k times indeterminate X^k over commutative ring R.

references.disposition: No finite degree is assigned to identically zero polynomial under this convention.

items.review_rationale: Read Kuratowski ordered pair representation as nested set {{a},{a,b}} and its coordinate equality characterization for arbitrary sets.

references.context: Basic finite sets assembled from the two input sets/elements.
Kuratowski set construction representing ordered pair (a,b).
Equality of represented pairs iff first coordinates match and second coordinates match.

references.phrase: ordered pair differs from unordered pair
references.disposition: Nested representation preserves coordinate order, even when values differ.
